Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a logical error in comparing the birth dates. Aryeh Ben-Eliezer was born in 1913 and Jason Pociask in 1983. Since 1913 is earlier than 1983, Aryeh Ben-Eliezer is the older individual (by approximately 70 years). The Planner incorrectly concluded that Jason Pociask is older because his birth date string (1983) is numerically greater than Aryeh's (1913), failing to understand that a larger birth year indicates a more recent birth, not an older age.
